name: As Above/So Below
source:
As Above/So Below is an epic science fiction action-romance set at the Grand Excelsior Academy of the Celestial Arts, a prestigious institution dedicated to the instruction of mech pilots.

[From [url=https://bigg-aasb.itch.io/as-aboveso-below-demo-11]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《如上/如是》是一部史诗般的科幻动作爱情片，背景设定在天艺大学院，这是一所致力于指导机甲飞行员的著名机构。

[来自[url=https://bigg-aasb.itch.io/as-aboveso-below-demo-11]itch.io[/url]]
